component.name: DeckPlayer
component.summary: Controller-first video and music player for handheld PCs

description.p: DeckPlayer is a native video and music player built from the ground up for Steam Deck and other handheld gaming PCs. Every control is reachable with a controller, and touch gestures cover the actions a gamepad cannot express.

ul.li: Full gamepad support: D-pad, sticks, face buttons, triggers and shoulder buttons
Touch gestures: double-tap to play or pause, swipe on either half of the screen for brightness and volume, horizontal swipe to seek
Plays virtually every format through the mpv engine, including embedded subtitles such as ASS and PGS
Music playback continues in the background while you browse your library
Add any folder as a media library; scanning is recursive and cached
Resume playback from where you left off, with per-file history
Extensible through plugins: video source plugins and metadata scrapers
Adapts to any screen size, from an 800p handheld panel to a 4K desktop monitor

description.p: DeckPlayer does not assume a small screen. It runs equally well on a desktop monitor, making it a practical everyday player.
